title: Genome-wide Association Studies of the Pathogenic Sphingosine-1-Phosphate Gene in Ulcerative Colitis.
authors: Chen, Hongyu; Shang, Jingyu; Zhao, Song; Xu, Luzhou; Shen, Hong
journal: Endocrine, metabolic & immune disorders drug targets
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过GWAS和机器学习识别溃疡性结肠炎中S1P相关关键基因，虽构建转录因子-mRNA网络但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease that can lead to malignancies over time. Sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) receptor signaling affects lymphocyte trafficking and vascular integrity, influencing intestinal inflammation. This study aimed to identify S1P-related key genes in UC. METHODS: Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between the UC and control groups were analyzed in the GSE87473 (training) dataset. Genes overlapping between the DEGs and S1P-related genes were considered candidate genes. These genes were incorporated into machine learning algorithms and subjected to expression analysis to identify key genes. Gene functions were determined through a gene-gene interaction network, enrichment analysis, and immune cell infiltration analysis. In addition, transcription factor-mRNA and mRNA-miRNA-lncRNA networks were constructed. Finally, reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) was performed to evaluate the expression of key candidate genes in UC and control tissues. RESULTS: This study identified two key genes (SPHK2 and SPNS2) associated with UC. Notably, SPHK2 expression was lower and SPNS2 expression was higher in the UC group in both training and validation datasets and in clinical UC tissues (RT-qPCR). The area under the curve values of SPHK2 and SPNS2 exceeded 0.7 in both datasets, indicating that the genes had good diagnostic efficacy for UC. Consistently, the nomogram showed that the two genes had promising diagnostic value in UC. SPHK2 and SPNS2 were found to be localized to the plasma membrane. The correlations of the two genes with different immune cells showed significantly opposite trends. In particular, SPHK2 had the strongest positive correlation with M2 macrophages (r = 0.6) and the strongest negative correlation with neutrophils. Moreover, mRNA-miRNA-lncRNA and transcription factor- mRNA networks of the key genes were constructed. CONCLUSION: This study suggests that SPHK2 and SPNS2 are key genes associated with UC, highlighting their potential as effective diagnostic biomarkers.
abstract_zh: 背景：溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）是一种慢性炎症性肠病，随时间推移可能发展为恶性肿瘤。鞘氨醇-1-磷酸（sphingosine-1-phosphate, S1P）受体信号影响淋巴细胞运输和血管完整性，从而调节肠道炎症。本研究旨在识别UC中与S1P相关的关键基因。方法：在GSE87473（训练）数据集中分析UC组与对照组之间的差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）。DEGs与S1P相关基因重叠的基因被视为候选基因。将这些基因纳入机器学习算法并进行表达分析以识别关键基因。通过基因-基因相互作用网络、富集分析和免疫细胞浸润分析确定基因功能。此外，构建了转录因子-mRNA和mRNA-miRNA-lncRNA网络。最后，采用逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction, RT-qPCR）评估关键候选基因在UC和对照组织中的表达。结果：本研究识别出两个与UC相关的关键基因（SPHK2和SPNS2）。值得注意的是，在训练和验证数据集以及临床UC组织（RT-qPCR）中，UC组的SPHK2表达较低，而SPNS2表达较高。在两个数据集中，SPHK2和SPNS2的曲线下面积值均超过0.7，表明这些基因对UC具有良好的诊断效能。一致地，列线图显示这两个基因在UC中具有潜在的诊断价值。SPHK2和SPNS2被定位于质膜。这两个基因与不同免疫细胞的相关性显示出显著相反的趋势。特别是，SPHK2与M2巨噬细胞呈最强正相关（r = 0.6），与中性粒细胞呈最强负相关。此外，构建了关键基因的mRNA-miRNA-lncRNA和转录因子-mRNA网络。结论：本研究提示SPHK2和SPNS2是与UC相关的关键基因，突出了它们作为有效诊断生物标志物的潜力。
